name: How long do common handyman repairs usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long do common handyman repairs usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the task. Simple fixes like hardware swaps, caulking, or minor adjustments may take under an hour, while drywall patching, door repair, or multiple punch-list items can take longer if drying time or part matching is involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small repairs can take under an hour; multi-step jobs like drywall patching or door repair may take longer if materials or drying time are needed.
